visual_action: A montage of clips shows various political rallies and protest marches. People are seen marching across a bridge and on streets, holding signs with slogans like "OUR TIME IS NOW", "DEFEND DEMOCRACY", and "HOLD LANDLORDS ACCOUNTABLE". Politician Zohran Mamdani is shown marching with a crowd and speaking at a podium. Politician Abigail Spanberger is shown on a stage at a rally with a large American flag behind her; in a very brief clip, she appears to do an acrobatic flip over the podium. The U.S. Capitol building is visible in the background of some protest scenes.

central_claim: The Democratic party and its supporters are a passionate, diverse, and unified movement of people actively fighting for their beliefs.
intended_effect: To inspire viewers with the energy and scale of the Democratic movement, fostering feelings of pride and solidarity.
